ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: The course will survey the algorithmic foundations of parallel computing. This includes basic parallel programming models; operation and communication complexity; basic parallel algorithms for linear algebra, FFT, sorting and graph algorithms; networks and routing. Restrictions: Restricted to Computer Science major(s). Restricted to students with Senior or Graduate class standing. Prerequisite: CS 374
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Computer Science or Electrical & Computer Engr major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
